scope: Read-only review of portability/packaging source and instructions; no additional reproduction, bootstrap or packaging execution by reviewer.
findings: Default verifier performs no network request, install, simulation or mission execution.
Network bootstrap requires both explicit flags, accepts only saved HTTPS files.pythonhosted.org URLs, checks final host, SHA256 and size, refuses mismatched existing bytes and installs no package.
Relative source paths are contained within the root and symlinks are rejected.
Staging refuses overwrite, copies exact included bytes, checks source/staged semantic identities, and creates an all-included-file manifest.
Manifest intentionally cannot include its own digest; final outer archive hash supplies that identity.

Canonical research wheels are checked against frozen jobs. Duplicate selected-wheel copies are omitted only when exact hash matches the canonical wheel; distinct synthetic failures remain in the full edition.
GitHub edition explicitly omits all wheel binaries and documents missing offline closure and synthetic fixture limitation.
Final archive requires completed evidence, README and LaTeX/PDF, uses a new outside-source destination, preserves partial failures and fixed entry metadata.
Existing relocation receipt records18 evaluations of the same6 jobs, identical decisions, no new missions, exact same native runtime and unchanged primary bytes; this review did not rerun it.
documentation_recommendation: Add M02 market replay/immutable-copy interpretation from manuscript review; do not alter frozen runner.
limits: Static review plus the builder owner's existing receipts, not a fresh independent packaging execution.
No cryptographic identity turns an untrusted recorder into independent attestation.
Same-runtime relocation does not establish arbitrary-platform support.
Post-snapshot delivery checks must be recorded in an outside delivery supplement to avoid impossible self-inclusion.
